doNotUse.$description: Used only to highlight deprecated components!

background-breadcrumb.$description: Used for the breadcrumb and sidebar components

secondary-button-hover.$description: This is the hover value for buttons, notifs & reminders.

tertiary-button.$description: CTA used for our splash pages

tertiary-button-hover.$description: Hover used for our splash page CTA

brand-primary-disabled.$description: Used to denote a disabled state for action text and primary buttons

background-tile.$description: Used specifically for tiles (container-primary as well)

background-toast-help.$description: Semantic used for the Help toast variant

text-primary.$description: In dark mode, this color will change from gray to white.

text-secondary.$description: In dark mode, this color will change from dark blue to white.

text-OnDark.$description: This color will change from white to its dark mode equivalent.

text-link.$description: Used specifically for clickable items, not for labels. In dark mode this color will change to it's dark equivalent.

text-OnLight.$description: This color will change from dark blue to its dark mode equivalent.

text-disabled.$description: This color will change from gray to its dark mode equivalent.

text-inverse.$description: This color will change from white to dark blue

text-success.$description: This color will change from green to its dark mode equivalent.

text-error.$description: This color will change from red to its dark mode equivalent.

text-label.$description: This should be used for static text only; above inputs, subheaders, labels etc. In dark mode, this color will change from blue to white.

text-black.$description: This is a rare use case. Text-secondary should be used in most all cases requiring darker text.

icon-primary.$description: Changes to its Dark Mode variant.

icon-secondary.$description: In dark mode, this color will change from white to RMX blue.

icon-disabled.$description: Used for disabled icon frames and strokes

icon-inverse.$description: This color will change from white to dark blue.

icon-opacity.$description: Used mainly for the disabled state of Toggle Sliders

icon-OnDark.$description: This color will change from white to its dark mode equivalent.

icon-Rm12.$description: This is for rm12 icons specifically
